capture: Actual Qt widgets and live TrainingEngine; scripted UI actions

events.caption: Train  |  Inspect values, action probabilities and source code
Preferences  |  Theme, text size, pacing and TensorBoard
Resume  |  Continue the same training session
Stop  |  Save the current training checkpoint
Restore  |  Load the saved parameters and progress
Continue  |  Train from the restored checkpoint
Math in RL Visual  |  Open-source learning workspace

note: Short demonstration; not a convergence or performance benchmark. User data and preferences are untouched.
